name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited
summary: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited, through its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and distributes beauty and lifestyle products in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Beauty, Fashion, and Others. The company offers makeup for face, eyes, lips, and nails, as well as makeup palettes and tools and brushes; body, eye lip, sun, and hands and feet care products, as well as moisturizers, serums, cleansers, masks, toners, skin tools and supplements, neck creams, Korean beauty products, and specialized skincare; hair care and styling products, as well as tools and accessories; appliances; bath and shower, feminine hygiene, female and male grooming products, hygiene essentials…
